 Follow Star Wars introduces two new names for the Force to describe the light and dark side
 Molly Edwards Fri, October 23, 2026 at 12:02 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. When you buy through links on our articles, Future and its syndication partners may earn a commission. 
 Credit: LucasFilm/Disney
 Star Wars has introduced a new way of referring to the Force, and it's connected to Kylo Ren.
 The new terminology comes from the Fall of Kylo Ren comic series by Charles Soule and Will Sliney. Per ScreenRant , after it was earlier revealed that the Knights of Ren call the dark side "The Shadow," it turns out that the light side is called "The Shine." That's revealed by Tava Ren, the woman who led the Knights of Ren after Kylo Ren allied with the First Order.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Plus, the latest issue, #3, sees Tava Ren referring to someone as potentially "radiant," possibly meaning Force-sensitive.
 It remains to be seen how this new way of describing the Force might affect the broader Star Wars lore, but, for now, they're interesting details that make the galaxy feel much bigger and more lived-in.
 Next up for Star Wars is Ahsoka season 2 , which also looks set to develop our understanding of the Force thanks to the inclusion of the Mortis gods and the World Between Worlds .
 "It's definitely a thing," Dave Filoni has previously said of the gods factoring into Ahsoka season 2.
 Advertisement Advertisement "It was so surprising when George [Lucas] created these archetype god characters," he also explained. "What were we examining there in Clone Wars? What was the metaphor? A lot of it is about power, and what you do with power, and how you wield power. For a Jedi, I think it's a natural story path to get into these questions."
 Ahsoka season 2 arrives on January 20. In the meantime, check out our guide to all the upcoming Star Wars movies and TV shows for everything else that's on the way.
